content: Yoãm te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux
Hãpxip 'ĩhã Yoãm tep-tox pix, tu hãpxexka Yonex yõg hãm panip xexka ha' mõg, nũy Topa pupi hãm'ãktux,
tu: —Mã', yãyhãhup, nũy hãpkummuk mĩy kux. Yã hõnhã Topa te 'ãxat nũnte' Kaxĩy.
Yã hõmã tik hittap 'Iyait te Yoãm 'ãktux, 'ĩhã Topa pupi hãm'ãktux, yĩy:

content.text: “Tik xip hãm panip xexka tu', tu' yĩy ka'ok, tu:
nũy Topa pu putat kohe tu' yoa'.”

content: 'Ũkux. Kaxĩy.
Yoãm te kãmẽn xeh hã topixxax mĩy, nũy tu xokxop xax hãg-nãy hĩy, tu kunit mãhã', xix puk hep xup.
Ha ta kõmẽn Yenoyanẽn yõg tikmũ'ũn xohix nũn, xix hãpxexka Yonex yõg tikmũ'ũn, xix tikmũ'ũn te kõnãg xexka Yohnãm yĩka' pip, tu' nũn,
ha Yoãm te tikmũ'ũn xohip-tox pix, 'ĩhã tikmũ'ũn te yãy yõg hãpkummuk mĩy'ax 'ãktux, tu yãyhãhup tu hãm'ãktux, nũy nõm kuxyã'.

Ha Paniye xop nũn kamah, xix Xanoxeo xop nũn, puyĩy Yoãm kamap-tox pix. Pa Yoãm te: —'Ãxop kummuk xop te kãyãk-tok putuk! Piyã 'ãxat, xayĩy 'õg hãpkummuk mĩy'ax tu kux, puyĩy Topa 'ãha gãy hok, nũy 'ãkummugã hok?
'Ãpu hãpxopmã max, pu tikmũ'ũn xohix xate yãyhãhup yũmmũg.
Hãm'ãktux hok, hu: “Yã mõnãyxop 'Amanãm yã yũmũ'ã hã mõnãyxop xe'e', 'a Topa te 'ũgkummugãp-tup'ah,” Kaxĩy. 'Ũxuktux hok! Yã Topa mũn ka'ok, tu mĩkax xap hã 'Amanãm mõkputox mĩy'ax.
Tikmũ'ũn te mĩm kup kummuk xak, kupuk hã' xak, tu kuxap hã mõ'hap, pu tu nõg, ha kaxĩy Topa te tikmũ'ũn kummuk kix putup, tu' nõa'.

'Ãte 'ãp-tox pix, tu kõnãg hã 'ãp-tox pix, xa yãyhãhup, nũy hãpkummuk mĩy hok 'ũxeheh, pa tik puxet tek pe' nũn putup, tu' ka'ok, ha tak pu'uk. 'Ap max'ah 'ãte nõ pataxax tat, yãk mũn kutõgnãg. Hamũn te Topa Koxuk xa mõ'kutnãp-tup puyĩy 'ãkuxa ka'ogã', nũy 'ãkuxa kummuk tupmã'.

Yã pẽnẽn paha', nũy xuxnãg xetox xap mõy mĩxux kopah, nũy xap xix mĩptut kopah, 'ĩhã mĩxux naknãg mõ'hap kuxap tu', ha kaxĩy Topa te yãy yõg tikmũ'ũn xex max, pa' yĩpkox 'ohnãg xop xũygãp-tup, kuxap hã' puk putuk nõ xũygãp-tup, ha' xũy xuxix tapax 'ohnãg. 'Ũkux. Kaxĩy.
Yoãm te Yeyox putox pix
Hãpxip kutõgnãg 'ĩhã Yeyox mõg, tu ta hãpxexka Ganinet tu' xip, tu kõnãg xexka Yohnãm ha' mõg, pu Yoãm putox pix,
pa Yoãm te: —'Ãmhok! Kaxĩy hok! Pak mũn putox pix 'ũyãnãn tu'! 'Ãxexka, hak mũn kutõgnãg. Teptu xatek xat, 'ũg 'ãp-tox pix? Kaxĩy.
Ha Yeyox te: —Topa te 'ãp-tup, xak putox pix. Yã puxi'. Kaxĩy. Ha: —Ya hamũn. Kaxĩy. Tup-tox pix.
Ha' pix kux, 'ĩhã Yeyox te kõnãg kox tu' xupep, ha pexkox xõn, ha Yeyox te Topa Koxuk pẽnãhã', ha ta tu' yĩxohoh kuxxuxtut putuk, tu mõktu Yeyox putox tonnok, tu yĩmũ' xip,
ha ta Topa yĩy, tu hãm'ãktux pexkox tu', hu: —Nũhũ 'ũgkutok pit. 'Ãte nõm mõ'yãy xe'ẽgnãg, hak kuxa hittupmãhã'! Kaxĩy.
